title: Song - Good King Wenceslas
subtitle: Arrangement: the tune with left-hand block chords
trains: A carol tune in the right hand over block chords (G, C, D) in the left, one chord per bar, hands together.

provenance.author: claude-sonnet-5
provenance.basedOn: mutopia-905-good-king-wenceslas: "Good King Wenceslas" (anonymous tune, words J. M. Neale), voice and piano-style setting; the tune is in the top voice (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=905)
provenance.note: Melody from Rev. Charles Lewis Hutchins, Carols Old and Carols New (Boston: Parish Choir, 1916), Carol #415 (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=905), public domain; left-hand chords our own (CC0)

departures: Left-hand block chords are our own (CC0).
Transposed down a major second, from A major to G major.
